high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from the Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) magazine, as indicated by the logo at the top left corner. The URL "magazine.fbk.eu" is visible in the address bar at the top of the screen. The content of the page discusses the importance of measurement and quantification in science, referencing Galileo Galilei. The text mentions that Galileo understood the value of measurement to know and manipulate the world, and that almost every quality of interest can be translated into something quantifiable.
